import 'chunk_extra_before.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final events = <String>[];
  final result = await mapWithConcurrency<int, int>([1, 2, 3], 2, (item) async {
    events.add('start$item');
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
    events.add('end$item');
    return item;
  });
  final first = events.take(6).join(',');
  if (first != 'start1,end1,start2,end2,start3,end3') throw StateError(first);
  if (result.join(',') != '1,2,3') throw StateError('$result');
  print(events.join(','));
}
